title: All 24 byte permutations of a 32-bit word need at most 3 of {ror, grev, shfl, unshfl}
statement: Reproduces Bitmanip draft Table 4.1 and adds what the spec omits: the exact per-permutation minima -- 6 permutations at length 1, 9 at 2, 8 at 3.

formal.statement: BFS over composed bit-position permutations from the identity over 92 concrete instructions.

scope: XLEN=32; ror k=1..31, grev k=1..31, shfl/unshfl k=1..15 per the v0.93 draft pseudocode.

provenance.by: isa-calculus bootstrap (Claude Code session with axeyum)
